description: Run SQL on a branch as the project's database role (never a superuser). Read-only by default. For writes pass read_only: false (database:write). DROP, TRUNCATE, ALTER ... DROP and DELETE/UPDATE without WHERE are destructive: they need confirm: true plus the destructive scope, and on production also production:destructive. Prefer migrations.apply for schema changes. Scope: database:read.

confirm.description: Must be true to run a destructive operation, after the user approved it

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

query.description: SQL. Read-only mode takes one statement; write mode takes a script run in one transaction.

read_only.description: Default true. Set false to write (needs database:write).

name: sql.execute
title: Run SQL
